svg.title: Fewer rounds of "make it better"
svg.desc: Rounds of review until a reviewer would ship the page. Lower is better. 18 blind runs across 3 design tasks. The reviewer did not know which setup made each page. A page never accepted counts as 5 rounds.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
